from decimal import Decimal

from invoicing.invoice import Invoice


def test_empty_invoice_subtotal_is_a_decimal() -> None:
    subtotal = Invoice("ACME").subtotal()
    assert isinstance(subtotal, Decimal)
    assert subtotal == Decimal("0.00")
